summary: Cadeler plc filed a 6-K confirming completion of its share-exchange offer for Cadeler A/S, executed to redomicile the group's parent from Denmark to the UK. Each Cadeler A/S share exchanged for one Cadeler plc share; roughly 7.94% of holders did not tender, lifting tendering holders' relative stake by 8.62%. Cadeler plc shares began trading on NYSE and Oslo Børs (ticker CDLR) on 5 November 2026. Exceeding 90% ownership, Cadeler plc will launch a Danish statutory squeeze-out at NOK 58.42 per share, funded via a DNB facility; A/S ADSs delist within ten days. Watch residual-holder squeeze-out timing and delisting mechanics.
